claims.description: Measurement is the lowest-performing mathematics competency across Karnataka based on statewide competency accuracy.
Kodagu is among the districts with the highest competency imbalance, with a Severity Gap of approximately 21 percentage points.
District-specific competency-based interventions are recommended because districts exhibit different weakest competencies and varying levels of competency imbalance.

verification_detail.reasoning: This recommendation is based on the combined interpretation of competency accuracy, Severity Gap analysis, and female literacy. It is a policy recommendation that requires expert evaluation rather than verification through a single numerical metric.
